title: Women and Family Fans: What Inclusive Growth Could Mean for Kolkata Knight Riders
dek: Growing Kolkata Knight Riders' fan base beyond its core means reaching women and families. The data cannot count them, but it can show when the cricket is easiest to attend.
excerpt: A share of Kolkata Knight Riders' matches fall on weekends and double-header days, the fixtures most suited to family attendance. Who actually comes is a question for audience research.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

{{ev:wf-dh}} fell on double-header days, when one IPL match starts in the afternoon.

sections.heading: Growth Beyond the Core
body: Inclusive growth means building a fan base that reflects the whole population: women, children and families as well as the traditional core. That growth needs different products, timings and experiences.
The CricField warehouse is ball-by-ball cricket data. It contains no audience gender, age or household data, so it cannot measure the commercial side of this question directly.

sections.heading: When the Cricket Is Easiest to Attend
body: Timing matters for families. {{ev:wf-wk}} of Kolkata Knight Riders' matches have been on a Saturday or Sunday, and {{ev:wf-dh}} fell on double-header days, when one of the day's two matches starts in the afternoon.
Kolkata Knight Riders have played {{ev:wf-hwk}} weekend matches at Eden Gardens: the fixtures where a family day out is most practical. The chart tracks both shares by season.

sections.heading: What Inclusive Growth Would Involve
body: Family pricing, safe and accessible stands, women-focused content and links with the women's game are the usual levers.

sections.heading: What a Study Would Need
body: Measuring progress would need ticket-holder demographics, survey data and digital-audience breakdowns over several seasons.
Without that, any claim about who attends is an assumption.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Use the Calendar
body: The fixtures most suited to families are a known, limited set each season. Kolkata Knight Riders can target those dates for family-focused offers.
Whether that grows the audience needs demographic data to show.
